expanded_element.description: The Blue Temple (Wat Rong Suea Ten) is a modern Buddhist temple in Chiang Rai featuring striking sapphire-blue architecture, intricate murals, and a white Buddha statue. It's 10 minutes from central Chiang Rai, free to enter, and open daily from 7am to 8pm.
